title: ClientLoaderFunctionArgs
summary: Client loader arguments with access to the server loader.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Extends LoaderFunctionArgs with serverLoader<T>(): Promise<T>. The application transport supplies this callback; invoking it requests the registered server loader.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: A client loader can return locally sourced data without calling serverLoader. The generic declares the server result contract; it does not validate JSON at runtime. A bare createDataRouter does not install a server transport callback.
